title: Central boot: state_load took 146 s and the listener bound only after 154 s (2026-11-11 reboot)
outcome: Central boot time to a bound listener is measured per sub-phase, its dominant cost is identified, and it is reduced or the reason it cannot be reduced is recorded with evidence.
acceptance: load_state_for_boot is broken down into timed sub-phases in the startup log (open, schema, per-table or per-session loading, transcript tails, derived rebuilds), and a boot of Central with that logging records which sub-phase dominates.
The dominant sub-phase is reduced, with a behavioural or measured before/after comparison recorded on this item, or a recorded measurement shows why it cannot be reduced and what it costs.
The comparison distinguishes a cold OS cache (first boot after a machine reboot) from a warm process restart, using recorded timings for both.
